# Vendored libraries

Loaded on demand (never on app start), and cached offline by the service worker.

| File | Library | Version | License | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pinyin-pro.js` | [pinyin-pro](https://github.com/zh-lx/pinyin-pro) (UMD build, global `pinyinPro`) | 3.28.1 | MIT | Pinyin for AI practice stories (same library as the translation pipeline) |
| `hanzi-writer.min.js` | [Hanzi Writer](https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer) (global `HanziWriter`) | 3.7.3 | MIT | Stroke-order animation and handwriting practice |

Hanzi Writer fetches per-character stroke data from `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hanzi-writer-data`
the first time a character is shown; the service worker keeps a copy for offline use.

`../data/zh-levels.tsv` is generated by `tools/wordfreq/build-zh-levels.mjs` from the official
HSK 2.0 word lists (via the `@leonsilicon/hsk2.0` package) plus jieba dictionary frequencies.
